method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: They said: we will not believe you until you make a spring gush out of the earth, or you have a garden of date palms and grapevines with rivers gushing through it, or a house of gold, or climb up into the sky. (Never shown: the one addressed, nor anyone for him, nor angels. Only the things demanded.)
ideas: A spring gushing out of dry cracked ground
A garden of date palms and grapevines with rivers running through it
A house of gold gleaming on a hill
A ladder rising into the clouds with nobody on it

sections.meaning: Nothing kept people from believing except 'has God raised up a human being as a messenger?'; God is enough as a witness between me and you. (Never shown: the messenger, nor anyone for him, nor angels.)
ideas: A weathered boundary stone standing between two fields in plain daylight

sections.meaning: Whoever God guides is the guided one; he who created the heavens and the earth has the power to create the like of them, and has set a term in which there is no doubt; if you owned the storehouses of my Lord's mercy you would hold back for fear of spending, and man is tightfisted. (Hell is not shown.)
ideas: A walker follows a line of white stones across a dark moor to a lit farmhouse
A child looks up at the Milky Way over a village
A miser hugs a huge sack of grain in a barn while hungry people wait at the open door

sections.meaning: We gave Moses nine clear signs; Pharaoh said 'you are bewitched'; he wanted to unsettle them from the land but we drowned him and those with him; we said to the Children of Israel: live in the land, and when the promise of the hereafter comes we will bring you as a mixed crowd. (No drowning shown.)
ideas: A dark cloud of locusts over a wheat field
Nine jars in a row each holding a different sign
A cart wheel half buried on a calm shore at sunrise
A mixed crowd of all kinds of people gathered in a wide field at morning

sections.meaning: With the truth we have sent it down, and with the truth it has come down; a Quran divided so that you may read it to the people slowly, and we have sent it down in stages.
ideas: Small waterfalls stepping down a hillside in stages
Rain falling steadily on a dry garden

sections.meaning: Those who were given knowledge before it, when it is recited to them, fall on their chins, bowing down, saying 'Glory to our Lord, the promise is carried out', weeping, and it increases them in humility.
ideas: A man kneels in a plain bright room, head bowed, tears on his face
A woman kneels weeping in a quiet field at dawn

sections.meaning: Call on God or call on the All-Merciful, to him belong the best names; do not be loud in prayer nor hushed, but seek a way between the two; praise belongs to God. And declare how great he is. (Never shown: the one addressed.)
ideas: A path between a roaring waterfall and a silent still pond
First light touching the highest peaks above a sea of cloud
